'''Cannibal Raised Vampires''' are like Cannibal Vampires — all stats raised by ~20% — with one difference, and it is the only difference: a Cannibal Raised Vampire can drink the blood of anything without losing its status. It has the pros of a cannibal with no cons at all, except for the sun, stakes, and other usual vampire weaknesses.

== How to Become One ==
Be infected by a Cannibal Vampire as a human. As you complete the transformation, there is a 1% chance you become Cannibal Raised.

⚠️ What happens on the remaining transformations is not confirmed.
